profile.headline: Software Engineer at Broward Sheriff’s Office (BSO)
profile.summary:
Engineer by degree and witty by spirit. Seasoned software developer with over a decade of success participating and leading projects in the design, development, testing and implementation of web and mobile applications. Leveraging proven ability to master and integrate diverse technologies into complex projects, meeting tight budgets and deadlines. Dedicated to overseeing all phases of development for multiple projects simultaneously in accordance with outlined budgets, timelines and deliverables.

Qualifications:

•	Over 14 years of experience in the software & optimization industry.
•	Strong knowledge of a wide spectrum of technologies and paradigms for software development. 
•	Excellent interpersonal skills. 
•	Learning is a positive constant.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
Work Assignment: Broward County Sheriff's Office

- Analysis of adherence to the best practices and security paradigms (PCI DSS. OWASP TOP 10) for all ITD department applications I have been involved.

company.name: Vitaver and Associates, Inc. (dba Vitaver Staffing)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer (Contract)
positions.description:
Work Assignment: Convey Health Solutions
- Performed PCI-DSS compliance analysis for the main web application (.NET).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop for a multi-channel platform enabling charities and non-profit organizations to fundraise on the web, social networks and mobile devices
- Support and enhance of large web and mobile applications. Wide use of windows, web programming, security standards implementations, open source and scripting technologies.

PCI DSS software best practices compliance. OWASP Top 10

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: CMS: DotNetNuke (DNN) and WordPress application administration and development

positions.title: Consulting Engineer
positions.description:
Developed custom mathematical model to forecast in a Multi-Skill inbound-Call Centre. Built the Multi-Skill inbound-Call Centre Simulator. 

Built better solution to provide the call centre agents with the required scripts: More than 100 Call Centre agents accessing scripts simultaneously to serve incoming client calls.
